title: Private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised…
description: Private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised, affecting the trust of certificates used by HCL Domino Server for outbound network requests. This compromise allows an unauthenticated network attacker to spoof server certificates and perform man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks, potentially intercepting or modifying outbound TLS traffic. The vulnerability is critical with a CVSS score of 9.1. No specific affected software versions or patches have been provided.
